query: event-stream npm OR package compromised OR malware OR hijacked OR supply chain attack

results.content: A popular npm package with nearly two million weekly downloads was compromised after an attacker gained publish rights and shipped a malicious dependency, flatmap-stream, designed to steal bitcoin wallet credentials from users of a downstream app.
results.title: Popular npm package event-stream compromised to steal bitcoin wallets

results.content: npm removed flatmap-stream and event-stream version 3.3.6 after confirming the package contained malicious code targeting a specific bitcoin wallet application. Users are advised to audit dependencies pinned to the affected versions.
results.title: Details about the event-stream incident

results.content: The event-stream incident shows how maintainer burnout and an unvetted handover of publish rights can turn a trusted dependency into a supply chain attack. The original maintainer transferred the package to an unknown contributor who shipped the malicious release.
results.title: How a dormant package became a supply chain attack vector
